solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Criminal making final bid to get outside

indicators.note: the bid word is to wrap around the final word, so one piece encloses the other

parts.note: an offer is a bid, as at an auction
the end is the final part

explanation.surface: A crook places one last bid at an auction and then walks out.
explanation.definitionFit: An offender is someone who commits a crime, a lawbreaker.

clue.text: In the team, on the wing, not breaking rules

definitions.meaning: selected, on the side that plays
playing out on a flank of the pitch, a position on one side
in football, not standing offside when the ball is played

explanation.surface: A footballer is picked, plays out wide and stays within the laws of the game.
explanation.definitionFit: Onside means legally positioned in football, and read as two words it also means picked for a side or playing on a flank.

clue.text: Keep dark for a couple of weeks

parts.note: a keep is the stronghold of a castle, a fort
the dark is night-time

explanation.surface: Someone is told to keep a secret quiet for two weeks.
explanation.definitionFit: A fortnight is a period of fourteen days, two weeks.

clue.text: Number one's direction is sound

parts.note: one is the Roman numeral I, and the 's adds an S
E is the compass direction east

explanation.surface: The leader's chosen course of action is sensible.
explanation.walkthrough: 'sound' looks like an adjective meaning sensible, but it is the noun meaning a din.
explanation.definitionFit: A noise is any sound, especially a loud one.

clue.text: Present some evidence at court

definitions.meaning: to present is to put on show or display
an item of evidence produced in a trial, labelled for the jury

explanation.definitionFit: To exhibit is to show something publicly, and an exhibit is an object shown to a court as evidence.

clue.text: Interfere with sound of gong

indicators.note: the clue asks for a word that is said like the gong word

parts.note: gong is slang for a medal or decoration

explanation.surface: Someone tampers with the noise a gong makes.
explanation.walkthrough: 'gong' suggests a struck metal disc, but it is British slang for a medal.
explanation.definitionFit: To meddle is to interfere in matters that are none of your business.

clue.text: Development of action due to training

indicators.note: developing something changes its form, so these words are rearranged

explanation.surface: Progress in taking action comes from training.
explanation.definitionFit: Education is the process of teaching and training someone.

clue.text: He wrote of French opposition

parts.note: de is the French word for of
a foe is an opponent, the opposition

explanation.surface: A writer produced something about French resistance.
explanation.walkthrough: Daniel Defoe was the English author of Robinson Crusoe.
explanation.definitionFit: Defoe was an English novelist and pamphleteer, so he is a man who wrote.

clue.text: Slack water at dusk

parts.note: slack water is still and level, even
the tide is the rise and fall of the sea's water

explanation.surface: The sea goes still and calm as evening falls.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Slack water' reads as one tidal term, but it splits into two pieces.
explanation.definitionFit: Eventide is an old poetic word for evening, the time of dusk.

clue.text: Honest view about retrograde art

indicators.note: the view word goes about the other piece, enclosing it

parts.note: a sight is a view, something seen

indicators.note: retrograde means moving backwards, so the word art is read in reverse

explanation.surface: A frank opinion on backward-looking painting.
explanation.definitionFit: Straight is informal for honest and frank, as in a straight answer.

clue.text: Very loud in order to annoy

indicators.note: the loud letters are placed in the order word

parts.note: a rule is an order or regulation
FF is fortissimo, the musical marking for very loud

explanation.surface: Someone makes a lot of noise to keep things tidy and irritate others.
explanation.definitionFit: To ruffle someone is to upset or irritate them, ruffle their feathers.

clue.text: Dramatic parts of the New Testament

definitions.text: Dramatic parts of the New Testament

parts.words: Dramatic parts of the New Testament
parts.note: plays divide into these sections, and the fifth book of the New Testament has the same name

explanation.definitionFit: Plays are divided into acts, and the Acts of the Apostles is a book of the New Testament.

clue.text: Not very bright, needs to be properly organised

indicators.note: organising letters properly puts them into a new order

explanation.surface: Someone not very clever has to be put in order.
explanation.definitionFit: Dense is an informal word for stupid, slow to understand.

clue.text: A butcher's working capital

indicators.note: letters at work are set into a new arrangement

explanation.surface: A butcher at work in a shop.
explanation.walkthrough: 'capital' seems to be money a business runs on, but it is a capital city: Bucharest is the capital of Romania.
explanation.definitionFit: Bucharest is the capital city of Romania.

clue.text: Confounded swindles having tag changed outside

indicators.note: the rearranged tag goes outside, wrapping around the swindles word
changing the word tag means rearranging its letters

parts.note: to have someone is to swindle or trick them, as in 'you've been had'

explanation.surface: Someone is baffled by cons involving a switched price label.
explanation.walkthrough: 'changed' makes AGT from 'tag', which goes 'outside' HAS.
explanation.definitionFit: Aghast means shocked and dismayed, confounded with horror.

clue.text: Describing one's descent from Lancaster

indicators.note: the answer is made from the letters of Lancaster, rearranged

explanation.surface: A family tree traces someone's line back to the House of Lancaster.
explanation.definitionFit: Ancestral means relating to one's ancestors, one's line of descent.

clue.text: Raced round the edge and made a mistake

indicators.note: the raced word goes round the edge word

parts.note: sped means raced, went fast
a lip is an edge or rim

explanation.surface: A runner went round the outside of a track too fast and slipped up.
explanation.definitionFit: To have slipped is to have made a small error, slipped up.

clue.text: Beef producer inside shows what may well be true

indicators.note: the beef producer is put inside the shows word

parts.note: parades are shows or displays
an ox is an animal kept for its beef

explanation.surface: A cattle beast is placed inside agricultural shows.
explanation.definitionFit: Paradoxes are statements that seem absurd yet may well be true.

clue.text: Makes fun of politician in saloon, drunk

indicators.note: the politician goes in the rearranged saloon
drunk suggests the letters stagger out of order

parts.note: an MP is a Member of Parliament

explanation.surface: A drunk politician in a bar mocks others.
explanation.walkthrough: 'drunk' makes LAOONS from 'saloon', and MP goes 'in' it.
explanation.definitionFit: To lampoon is to satirise or ridicule someone publicly.

clue.text: Object of broadcast recital

indicators.note: broadcast means scattered widely, so the letters are scattered

explanation.surface: Something about a recital that was put out on radio.
explanation.definitionFit: An article is an object or item, as in an article of clothing.

clue.text: Is not any faster at splitting points

indicators.note: the at word splits the points, going between them

parts.note: E and S are compass points, east and south

explanation.surface: Someone is no quicker at dividing up the scores.
explanation.walkthrough: 'faster' looks like a comparison of speed, but means one who fasts: someone who eats is not fasting.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone who eats is not fasting, so is not any kind of faster.

clue.text: Neglect desolate region

indicators.note: desolate suggests devastation, so the letters are wrecked into a new order

explanation.surface: An empty wasteland that people pay no attention to.
explanation.definitionFit: To ignore something is to neglect it, pay it no attention.

clue.text: Do you agree? I don't believe it!

explanation.definitionFit: The phrase can literally request assent, and is also an idiom of exasperated disbelief.

clue.text: Prayer in New Latin, used at day's end

indicators.note: new means remade, so the word Latin is rearranged
the end of the word is its last letter

explanation.surface: A prayer in modern Latin is said at evening.
explanation.definitionFit: A litany is a form of prayer with a series of petitions and responses.

clue.text: As parties go wild, they need indulgent hosts

indicators.note: letters going wild are thrown into disorder

explanation.surface: Freeloaders turn up when parties get out of hand and hosts are generous.
explanation.definitionFit: Parasites live off host organisms, and figuratively off generous people.

clue.text: One backing a horse, it may be added

definitions.meaning: a person sitting on a horse's back
an extra clause attached to a document or bill

explanation.definitionFit: A rider sits astride a horse, and a rider is also an added clause or condition.

clue.text: They have a central meeting place

definitions.text: They have a central meeting place

parts.words: They have a central meeting place
parts.note: lines drawn from the middle of a circle to its edge all meet at the centre

explanation.definitionFit: Radii of a circle all run from its centre, so they meet in the middle.

clue.text: A master of many subjects

parts.note: sounds like a scholar, but means a monarch over many people

explanation.definitionFit: A ruler such as a king governs subjects, the people of a realm.

clue.text: Sends away for books

definitions.meaning: reserves, as with a table or tickets

explanation.definitionFit: To order is to request goods to be sent, or to book something in advance.

clue.text: Six delay treating word-blindness

indicators.note: treating something processes it, so the letters are reworked

explanation.surface: Six patients wait to be treated for a reading condition.
explanation.definitionFit: Dyslexia is a learning difficulty affecting reading, once called word-blindness.

clue.text: Certainly depend on American setback

indicators.note: in an across clue, one piece on another follows it
set back means turned backwards, so the American word is reversed

parts.note: US is short for American, United States
to rely is to depend

explanation.surface: Count on a reversal of fortune in America.
explanation.definitionFit: Surely means certainly, without doubt.

clue.text: Island off the Needles?

parts.note: suggests an island near the Needles rocks, but means a knitted sweater just finished on knitting needles

explanation.walkthrough: The Needles are chalk rocks off the Isle of Wight; a guernsey is also a thick knitted sweater, here fresh off the knitting needles.
explanation.definitionFit: Guernsey is a Channel Island and also a knitted woollen jumper, which comes off knitting needles.
